name: Ragas
what_it_is: A toolkit for evaluating and optimising Large Language Model applications, in its maintainers’ words, with metrics aimed at the retrieval path — whether retrieved context supported the answer, and whether the answer stayed within it.
why_it_matters: It gives retrieval failures a number, which is the difference between "the answers feel worse" and knowing that recall dropped when the chunking changed. The metrics are themselves model-judged, so they carry the judge’s biases and cost a model call each — a measurement instrument that needs its own scrutiny.
suitable_for: Retrieval pipelines where answer quality depends on what was fetched
Catching regressions when chunking or embeddings change
Teams who have questions and reference answers to test against
not_suitable_for: Applications with no retrieval step to measure
Teams with no reference set, where there is nothing to score against
Cases where a model-judged score cannot be justified to a stakeholder
